data.name: Rutba
data.gender_notes: Rutba is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rutba is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rudhra', which means 'Sun'. This name is believed to bring sunshine into one's life, signifying power, strength, and prosperity. It is also associated with the god Rudra, who is the lord of all the gods and represents the creative force of the universe. The name Rutba carries the meaning “Sun, Power, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rutba usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, power, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rutba is a divine name that represents the supreme power of the universe. It is believed to bring blessings of the gods and bestow the bearer with strength, courage, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Rutba belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, Power, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rutba total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
